composition_label: Product comparison (Smart product search) -> Ticket triage & routing (AI customer support)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory

input.products: Nonempty array of unique trimmed id, name, attributes, features. price_usd required; other supported attributes optional.

attributes.price_usd: Nonnegative numeric USD or quantity with USD/$ suffix; minimize
attributes.ram_gb: Nonnegative numeric GB or GB/MB suffix, 1024 MB per GB; maximize
attributes.storage_gb: Nonnegative numeric GB or GB/TB suffix, 1024 GB per TB; maximize
attributes.battery_hours: Nonnegative numeric hours or h/hours/min suffix; maximize
attributes.weight_kg: Nonnegative numeric kg or kg/g suffix; minimize

input.preferences: Nonempty weights object of supported attributes with finite positive weights; required_features array; optional nonnegative max_price_usd.
input.tickets: Array, possibly empty, of unique trimmed id and nonempty text; optional product_id must reference input products.
input.routing: Ordered rules with category, keywords, signals, priority, team and owner; fallback requires category, priority, team, owner; priority_keywords requires high and urgent arrays.

output.comparison: Normalized products with score contributions, eligibility, missing fields/features, signals and ranks; ranked IDs; nullable recommended ID; side-by-side rows keyed by product ID.
output.triage: One record per input ticket: ticket_id, category, priority, accountable team and owner, reasons, and comparison_context.
output.error: status=error and error message; process exit 2

shared_schema.validation: Shared require/obj/text/number/strings helpers; reject unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys and IDs, malformed quantities, nonfinite numbers, booleans as numeric values, unsupported units, missing owners and invalid references. Deterministic comparison handoff is recomputed and checked before triage.

cross_stage_handoffs.validation: validate_comparison enforces exact deterministic comparison contract before ticket processing.
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Explicit product references use that product's comparison signals. Unreferenced tickets use the eligible recommended product. Rule signal matches can categorize and route tickets even without keyword matches; comparison context is copied into each routed result.

behavior.normalization: Unit suffixes and features are case-insensitive; numeric attributes are already in canonical units. No exchange rates or implicit unsupported unit conversion.
behavior.ranking: Weighted min-max utility over observed values; equal observed values get utility 1; missing weighted attributes get utility 0 and make product ineligible. Eligible products sort first, then descending score, then ascending product ID.
behavior.eligibility: Within optional price cap, includes every required feature, and has every weighted attribute. No eligible product yields null recommendation, not an unsupported substitute.
behavior.routing: First ordered rule with any case-insensitive whole-word keyword/phrase or propagated signal match wins. Otherwise explicit fallback applies. Match reasons are retained.
behavior.priority: Rule/fallback baseline normal/high/urgent; configured text matches may only escalate priority.
behavior.accountability: Every rule and fallback must include nonempty team and owner.
behavior.null_context: Unreferenced ticket with no eligible recommendation has null product/rank/score and no comparison signals; text and fallback routing remain active.
behavior.determinism: No clock, randomness, external services or model calls. Input is not mutated. JSON output has sorted keys.
behavior.fixture: All supplied products, support owners and tickets are explicitly synthetic.

included: Five fixed numeric comparison attributes and feature constraints
Configurable ranking weights, routing rules and priority keywords
CLI JSON success and error contracts
excluded: Live search, model providers or LLM steps
Network access, databases and persistent ticket delivery
Currency conversion and arbitrary attribute ontologies
Authentication, enterprise deployment and production service guarantees
Semantic language understanding beyond deterministic keyword rules
scope.administrative_artifact: docs\My_prompt.txt records supplied prompts as required by the repository prompt-log instruction; it is additional to the four requested root deliverables.

coverage: Keyword categories, priority escalation and accountable assignment
Invalid numbers, units, structures and references
Subprocess CLI success, usage and missing-file errors
Malformed JSON, duplicate keys and invalid schema errors
